archimate:CourseOfAction.name: 5. Establishing the Regional Delivery Office (RDO)
archimate:CourseOfAction.documentation:
Giving regional colleagues dedicated support and consistency so they can focus more on delivery.​
Not a priority pre-Christmas – design activity planned for January – March. ​
Level 2 capabilities are: Operations oversight​ Operational risk management ​ Portfolio, programme and project management ​ Strategic prioritisation and triage​ Pipeline development ​ Governance ​
